text:
Alex: FYI SI deployment for AcmeCorp failed on first boot, looks like driver mismatch between their node image and our marketplace bundle. logs attached.

Alex: ```
[ERROR] cuInit failed: CUDA driver version is insufficient for runtime
Found: libcuda.so.1 -> 525.89, container expects 530.30
Kernel: 5.4.0-89-generic
```

Tera: Can you paste the marketplace image tag and the node GPU SKU? Also @Priya_SI can you confirm the driver they installed?

Priya_SI: Node is on-prem Dell R7525 with A100s (PCIe). They installed vendor driver 525.89 from their systems team; marketplace image is `redwood/mktp:gpu-530-quant-2026-03`. Air-gapped install so they can't pull 530 easily.

Tera: Ok. Two options: 1) Backport a hotfix build of our image pinned to driver 525.x (quick, ~3-4h validation) or 2) recommend they update node driver to 530.x (longer, sysadmin window). For air-gapped, (1) is easier.

Marco_PM: Heads up, if we publish a backport image we need a short partner-facing comms note and an updated marketplace bundle version. ETA for comms? @Alex

Alex: I can draft a one-paragraph comms. Priorities: unblock SI P0, then follow up with marketplace patch. Q: do we need kernel-module rebuilds for 525? @Tera

Tera: No kernel rebuild expected; it's strictly driver-userland mismatch. We'll run smoke tests for perf and quant kernels. I'll take the hotfix build and smoke validation. @deploy-bot can you open an internal hotfix ticket?

deploy-bot: Created HOTFIX-1179: backport marketplace image -> driver 525.x. Assignee: Tera. Target: 2026-03-12 22:00 UTC. Link: https://redwood.internal/hotfix/HOTFIX-1179

Priya_SI: Thanks — if you can share the backport image digest I can stage it into our airgapped repo (we've got manual import procedures). If possible want a canary on 1 node first.

Tera: Will do. Plan: build backport tag `redwood/mktp:gpu-525-backport-20260312`, smoke on 3 A100 nodes, share digest + import instructions, then Priya runs 1-node canary. I'll post test matrix and perf diffs here. :thumbsup:

Alex: Owners: Tera (hotfix + smoke), Priya_SI (canary import + verification), Marco_PM (partner comms), Alex (announcement draft). Goal: unblock customer within 24h. Any objections?

Marco_PM: No objections. I'll prep the comms and coordinate marketplace packaging once you confirm build.

Priya_SI: No objections. Thanks team.

Tera: Posting smoke snippet once done:
```bash
# smoke test
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,name --format=csv
python -m pytest tests/smoke/gpu_smoke.py -k quant_kernels
```

Alex: Great. We'll circle back when HOTFIX-1179 progresses. /cc @oncall-infra
